vo: Right now, running School of Maths means notes on WhatsApp, tests on paper, fees in a register… and no real idea which student is stuck where.
caption: Notes on WhatsApp. Tests on paper. Fees in a register.

vo: So we built School of Maths its own app — everything in one place.
caption: So we built School of Maths its own app.

vo: Set up your batches in minutes. Students join with a code, and you approve who gets in.
caption: Batches, join codes and approvals

vo: Share notes and study material instantly. Every page is watermarked with the student's name, so your notes stay yours.
caption: Notes on every phone, watermarked with the student's name

vo: Build tests from your question bank in a few clicks — class tests, practice tests, daily practice. Students take them on their phones.
caption: Class tests, practice tests and daily practice

vo: Results and reports are ready the moment the test ends.
caption: Instant results, leaderboards and PDF reports

vo: But here's what really matters. School of Maths finds every weak topic — for the whole class, and for every student.
caption: Every weak topic — for the class and for each student

vo: Aarav is struggling with quadratic equations. Thirty-nine percent.
caption: Aarav · Quadratic Equations · 39% · Weak

vo: So the app tells him exactly what to practise — every day.
caption: Focus Today: practise Quadratics

vo: Two class tests later… thirty-nine becomes seventy-seven. Weak becomes strong. You watch it happen.
caption: 39% → 77% · Weak → Strong

vo: Your whole class, getting better — and you can see exactly how.
